Service.discover.sideEffects: read-only HTTP GET /api/info; never spawn or kill

Service.ensure.sideEffects: SIGTERM/SIGKILL registered pid and rm file when judged incompatible/unresponsive, then spawn

client.event.subscribe.note: process-wide SSE; no replay; no auto-reconnect

client.session.create.input: title?, agent?, model?: ModelRef, location?: {directory}, metadata?, permissions?: Ruleset

client.session.prompt.returns: SessionInboxUser { id, sessionID, type:'user', payload, delivery }
client.session.prompt.input: sessionID, text, files?, agents?, skills?: ReadonlyArray<{ id: string, mention?: { start, end, text } }>, delivery?: 'steer'|'queue', id?, resume?
client.session.prompt.skillsNote: input is catalog skill ids only; response payload.skills expands to { id, name, text }

client.session.skill.note: id is a catalog skill id. Paths 404 SkillNotFoundError. Appends a type:skill context message and session.skill.activated.

client.session.command.input: { sessionID, name: string, text: string, files?, agents?, skills?, delivery? }
client.session.command.note: name is CommandInfo.name from GET /api/command. No path.

client.session.fork.returns: SessionInfo with fork?: { sessionID, boundary: { type:'before'|'through', messageID } }
client.session.fork.openapi: POST body { before?: msg_ | null } additionalProperties false
client.session.fork.liveBefore: exclusive: copies history before the named message, does not include it
client.session.fork.liveThrough: raw HTTP { through: msg_ } returned 200 but truncation was NOT proven; typed client has no through field

client.session.instructions.entry.put.note: replaces that API key only; event announces as api/<key> hash at next step boundary

client.skill.list.SkillInfo: { id, name, description?, autoinvoke?, path: string, content: string }

client.session.compact.returns: SessionInboxCompaction { id, sessionID, type:'compaction', payload, delivery }

client.permission.reply.note: NOT client.session.permission.reply; event payload uses data.reply not data.decision

ModelInfo.variants: Array<{ id: string, settings?, headers?, body? }>
PromptSkillAttachment: { id, name, text?, mention? } /* stored/expanded; prompt input is { id, mention? } */
EventSubscribeOutput: V2Event object (client already JSON-decoded; OpenAPI V2EventEncoded is a JSON string)
